listing.name: Crash of the Titans (Xbox 360) — CrashRecomp: Definitive Edition (VitoMiguelF)
listing.summary: The project reports story, menus, saves and performance in specific v1.04 scenes; a complete campaign is unconfirmed. Newer source instructions describe 21:9, 32:9 and 16:10 display modes, GPU-dependent DLSS/FSR and an Intel UHD black-flicker problem with gpu_safe_mode and diagnostic workarounds. Windows 10/11 x64 and Vulkan 1.3 remain required; Linux through Proton is an unconfirmed goal. The v1.05 installer and layout were described before a public tag was available. Portcove has not tested that package or player. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own complete extracted retail Xbox 360 Crash of the Titans folder, including default.xex, default.rcf, english.rcf, sound1.rcf, sound2.rcf and shaders. The installer checks one known XEX SHA-256; this guide does not include the full accepted hash.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the version-matched instructions for the published CrashRecomp-v1.04.zip (155742930 bytes), CrashSetup.exe and your own supported game folder. Its tools recompile and build locally. Newer README instructions describe an offline CrashSetup-v1.05.exe, CrashLauncher.exe, CrashOTTDE.exe and userdata, but the v1.05 tag was unavailable when checked on 2026-10-25 at 07:06:52.013 UTC. This guide does not establish that installer as available. Source-clone dist/CrashRecomp.exe and older ZIP instructions are version-specific. Optional HD, subtitle and other derived assets have separate requirements.
